// evaluated for its effect; exports nothing anybody binds
globalThis.__jsModFixtureSideEffect = true;

// ...AND IT REFLECTS ON ITSELF, 2026-09-08 (w_meta_property). `import.meta` is
// the one construct that points a module at ITSELF rather than at another
// module, and `module_meta[code]` is the modules layer's row for it.
//
// THIS FILE AND NOT a.ts, for the reason exp.ts states in its own header: a.ts
// is compared site for site against node's own resolver and every assertion
// there is keyed on `(file, line, specifier)`. `import.meta` is neither an
// import site nor an export site — `module_site[code]` does not move, the
// oracle enumerates exactly what it enumerated before, and this file already
// exists to be evaluated for its effect.
globalThis.__jsModFixtureMetaUrl = import.meta.url;
